privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains which personal data entrenanutricion processes, what for, and what rights you have, under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and the Spanish Organic Law 3/2018 on Data Protection.

controller.title: Data controller
controller.body: {{controller}}. You can write about any privacy matter to {{contact}}.

data.title: Which data we process
data.body: Account data (first name, last name, email, date of birth, sex and photo, if you upload one); onboarding data (height, weight, goals, activity level and training and diet preferences); health data (medical conditions, supplements and food restrictions); your activity in the app (completed workouts with their sets and loads, weight records, training days and time, the food diary and badges); and the notes you exchange with your team.

purposes.title: What we use them for
purposes.body: To manage your account, so that the platform's trainers and nutritionists prepare and assign your plans, to show you your progress, to confirm your email and, if you turn them on, send you training reminders, and to keep the service secure. We do not use your data for advertising and we do not sell it.

legalBasis.title: Legal basis
legalBasis.body: The provision of the service you request when signing up (art. 6.1.b GDPR) for account and activity data, and your explicit consent (art. 9.2.a GDPR) for health data. You can withdraw your consent at any time by deleting your account from your profile.

recipients.title: Who accesses your data
recipients.body: Only the platform's professionals (trainers, nutritionists and administrators) who manage your plans. The technical providers that host the service (servers, database, file storage and email delivery) act as data processors. Technical error reports do not include personal data.

retention.title: How long we keep them
retention.body: While your account is active. If you delete your account, your data is deleted at once. If an administrator deactivates your account, it is deleted for good after {{days}} days. Backups are kept for {{backupDays}} days.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: You can access your data and take it with you (Profile › Download my data), correct it (Profile › Edit), erase it (Profile › Delete my account), and object to or ask to restrict the processing by writing to {{contact}}. If you think your request was not handled properly, you can complain to the Spanish Data Protection Agency (www.aepd.es).

security.title: Security
security.body: Communications are encrypted (HTTPS), passwords are stored with a strong hash, files are kept in private storage and each professional only accesses what their role needs. When a professional views your health data, who and when is recorded (never the data itself); you will find it in your data download. So that you can train without coverage, your device keeps a copy of your plan, workouts and exercises, which is deleted when you log out.
